170: def create_token(user_id: int, secret: str, lifetime_seconds: int) -> str:
171:     now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
172:     header = {"alg": "HS256", "typ": "JWT"}
173:     payload = {
174:         "sub": str(user_id),
175:         "iat": int(now.timestamp()),
176:         "exp": int((now + timedelta(seconds=lifetime_seconds)).timestamp()),
177:     }
178:     segments = [
179:         _base64url_encode(json.dumps(header, separators=(",", ":")).encode()),
180:         _base64url_encode(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")).encode()),
181:     ]

183:     signature = hmac.new(

185:     ).digest()

197:             _base64url_decode(encoded_signature), expected_signature

201:         payload = json.loads(_base64url_decode(encoded_payload))
